C26.name: Diploma in Aerospace Engineering
C26.description: Covers aircraft structure, aerodynamics, jet engines, flight mechanics, and aviation maintenance practices.

C31.name: Diploma in AI & Data Engineering
C31.description: Focuses on artificial intelligence, machine learning, big data analytics, and intelligent cloud systems.

C41.name: Diploma in Sustainability in Engineering with Business
C41.description: Blends sustainable engineering competencies with business management, circular economy principles, and product innovation.

C62.name: Diploma in Advanced & Digital Manufacturing
C62.description: Focuses on Industry 4.0 smart factory solutions, 3D printing/additive manufacturing, digital twin simulation, and industrial automation.

C71.name: Diploma in Biomedical Engineering
C71.description: Integrates engineering principles with medical sciences to develop healthcare electronics, medical devices, and bio-instrumentation.

C75.name: Diploma in Cloud Engineering
C75.description: Focuses on cloud infrastructure architecture, cloud-native application development, cloud security, and automated deployment.

C87.name: Diploma in AI Robotics
C87.description: Integrates mechanical engineering, electronics, autonomous systems, sensors, AI-powered robotics, and programmable logic controllers.

C89.name: Diploma in Electronic & Computer Engineering
C89.description: Combines electronics with hardware systems, microcontrollers, IoT devices, and cyber-physical security.

C24.name: Common Business & Technology Programme
C24.description: A foundational first-year program bridging business acumen and technological skills before specialisation.
modules_yr2: Specialization selection takes place in Year 1 Semester 2

C42.name: Common Engineering Programme
C42.description: A foundational first-year program allowing students to explore various engineering disciplines before choosing a specific diploma.
careers: Exploratory Engineering Track (leads to all SEG Diplomas)
modules_yr2: Specialization selection takes place in Year 1 Semester 2
